name: Confidentiality
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacred responsibility of guarding secrets and maintaining trust within relationships, as God knows the innermost thoughts of the heart. Faithfulness in confidentiality is contrasted with the destructive nature of slander and gossip, which can sever friendships and sow discord. A prudent and faithful person conceals knowledge and seeks love by covering transgressions, while the fool or whisperer reveals secrets and causes strife, demonstrating the importance of discretion in preserving unity and love among believers.
